See the manifest entry for why this could not be captured.
_masked: access_token and refresh_token are placeholders — on the wire they are live bearer tokens. expires_in is the prod/dev config's access_token_ttl (15m). Status codes, header and error envelopes are the backend's own as transcribed.

rotated._note: A live refresh token: rotated, so the reply carries its successor.

grace._note: The token presented was rotated less than refresh_token_grace_period (30s) ago — a racing tab or request. refreshWithinGrace mints an access token and sets RefreshToken to "" ("the client keeps the one it has"); omitempty drops the key entirely.

reuse._note: A rotated token presented past its grace window: reuseRevoked revokes the whole family and answers ErrTokenReuse.

loggedOut._note: Revoked without a successor (logout), or a grace reply for a family that is no longer live: ErrLogoutAlready.

expired._note: Idle past session_inactive_lifetime (168h) or older than session_max_lifetime (720h from sign-in): ErrTokenExpired.

invalid._note: No row for the token's hash: ErrInvalidRefreshToken.

lockBusy._note: Another refresh of the same token holds the distributed lock, which does not wait. Swagger documents 409 here; the code answers 429 with Retry-After: 1.
